name: Earth Corporation
summary: Earth Corporation engages in the manufacture, marketing, import, and export of pharmaceutical products, quasi-drugs, medical tools, and household products in Japan and internationally. It operates in two segments, Household Products Business, and Comprehensive Environmental Hygiene Business. It provides household insect control products; gardening supplies; daily necessities, such as mouthwash, denture-related products, toothpaste products, bath salts, deodorant air fresheners, etc.; pet products; epidemic prevention/agricultural, forestry, and livestock chemicals; and raw materials.
